verdict_line: New business signings up 34% against revenue growth of 4.3% — the gap between sold and live is implementation capacity, and it widens every quarter. A $2.7B pipeline and a 90%-complete Wincanton integration on top.

thesis.text: Signings are outrunning delivery. Approximately $410 million of new business signed in the quarter, up 34% — the strongest in three years — against revenue growth of just 4.3%.

The committed book is large and dated. Contracts won through Q2 are expected to generate roughly $1 billion of incremental 2026 revenue (+29%) plus a further $353 million for 2027. Record sales pipeline of approximately $2.7 billion as at 29 July 2026.

Margin is under pressure while this happens. Operating income fell to $77 million from $89 million even as adjusted EBITDA rose to $219 million — the cost of standing up new sites lands before the revenue does.

Two technology programmes are live: GXO IQ has moved from launch to scaled deployment, and the Wincanton integration is around 90% complete, on track for $60 million of run-rate synergies by year end.

exhibits.title: The implementation gap
exhibits.headline: Signings grew 34% while revenue grew 4.3% — the difference is work sold but not yet stood up.
exhibits.body_html: Revenue $3.441 billion (+4.3%, organic 3.4%), operating income $77 million (from $89 million), net income attributable to GXO $25 million, adjusted EBITDA $219 million (from $212 million), adjusted diluted EPS $0.59 (from $0.57). Around 40% of new wins were in the strategic verticals — aerospace and defence, technology, industrial and life sciences. Net leverage improved to 2.6x from 3.0x. Management noted humanoid-robot deployments are not yet at ROI, roughly two years from production use.
exhibits.sowhat: In contract logistics every win is an implementation: WMS configuration, client system integration, automation commissioning, data flows. A 34% signing rate against 4.3% revenue growth is the most direct services opportunity on the roster, and it compounds.

financials.basis: Verified from primary filings. Quarters shown as a dash could not be read from a primary source in this pass and are deliberately left empty rather than estimated.
